subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Military Romance Scam
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Military Romance Scam.

hook.text: A soldier deployed overseas can't access their bank account. They need you to send money.

buildup.text: Scammers pose as deployed military personnel because it explains why they can never meet in person.

discovery.text: They use real soldiers' photos stolen from social media profiles and memorial pages.

twist.text: The U.S. military never charges soldiers for leave, communication, or medical care overseas.

climax.text: Victims send thousands for fake plane tickets, medical bills, and satellite phone charges.

punchline.text: A real soldier doesn't need your money to come home.

quiz.question: Why do romance scammers often pose as deployed military?
options: Deployment explains why they can't meet in person
